en.dr-ali-peiravi: 3-43 Hamzih ibn Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Alavi - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim quoted his father, on the authority of Al-Nawfaly, on the authority of Al-Sakoony, on the authority of Ja’far ibn Muhammad (MGB), on the authority of his forefathers (MGB), on the authority of Ali (MGB),
“The Prophet of God (MGB) admonished against defecation in three locations: along the edges of a body of water; alongside a river; and under fruit-bearing trees.”
